_comment: Model registry for the local agent. Edit this file to add or retune models.
Ports: 8081 is deliberately skipped - it is the GLM-OCR server.
min_free_mb is the free physical RAM the manager insists on before starting
a model. Measured basis: GLM-OCR's 906 MB file uses 683 MB resident, a ratio
of ~0.75, so small models get file*0.8 plus ~250 MB headroom. 'reasoning' is
deliberately far more conservative: at 4.8 GB it cannot stay resident on an
8 GB machine and pages from disk, so it needs real headroom, not a formula.

models_dir points at local-agent/weights. runner.bat reads its own path from ../config_model.txt, which was updated to match. Forward slashes are used deliberately: Windows accepts them and they cannot be mistaken for escape sequences.

models.label: Ministral 3B
models.description: Primary model for everyday work. Mistral's native function-calling template. Native context is 262k but is capped at 4096 here, because the KV cache for anything larger will not fit.

models.label: Qwen3.5 2B (M)
models.description: Quick answers, short tasks, simple tool calls.

models.label: Qwen3.5 2B (XS)
models.description: Smallest and quickest. Q3_K_S is a harsher quant than the others, so expect weaker instruction-following.

models.label: Qwen3 8B
models.description: Harder reasoning and longer tasks. Slow on this machine.
